title: 搭乘大眾運輸
description: 搭乘公車、捷運、火車的常用對話

sentences.en: Which platform does the train to the airport depart from?
sentences.zh: 往機場的火車從哪個月台出發？

sentences.en: What's the next stop?
Do I need to transfer to get to the city center?
How much is a one-way ticket?
Where can I buy a transit card?
Is this the right bus to the museum?
sentences.zh: 這班公車有到博物館嗎？

sentences.en: How often does the subway come?
I'd like to top up my transit card.
sentences.zh: 我想要加值我的交通卡。

sentences.en: Which line should I take to get to the station?
sentences.zh: 我應該搭哪條線到那個站？

sentences.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，這個位子有人坐嗎？

sentences.en: The train is running ten minutes late.
Where is the nearest subway station?
Does this bus stop at the hospital?
sentences.zh: 這班公車有在醫院停嗎？

sentences.en: I missed my stop. What should I do?
sentences.zh: 我坐過站了。我該怎麼辦？

sentences.en: Is there a schedule for the express train?
Please let me know when we reach downtown.
sentences.zh: 到市區的時候請告訴我。

sentences.en: The last train leaves at midnight.
Can I bring my bicycle on the train?
sentences.zh: 我可以帶腳踏車上火車嗎？

sentences.en: Where do I tap my card?
This is the terminal station. All passengers must exit.
sentences.zh: 這是終點站，所有乘客請下車。

sentences.en: How many stops until we get there?
Is there a direct route, or do I have to change lines?
sentences.zh: 有直達的路線嗎，還是要換線？

sentences.en: The platform is on the second floor.
I'd like a round-trip ticket, please.
Which exit should I take for the park?
The bus comes every fifteen minutes.
Please move to the back of the bus.
I need to get off at the next stop.
Are there priority seats for the elderly?
The train is packed during rush hour.
sentences.zh: 尖峰時段火車擠滿了人。
